sample_unit: AI-generated photographs (100 per specialty across 19 specialties)

links.outcome: Gender representation of physicians in DALL-E 2 images versus US workforce and resident data
links.effect: Versus workforce, women overrepresented in 7/19 and underrepresented in 6/19 specialties; versus residents, underrepresented in 12/19 (10% to 36%); women <50% in 17/19 specialties.
links.quote: gAI created a sample population of physicians that underrepresented women when compared to both the resident and active physician workforce.

screen.reason: Empirical audit evaluating demographic and gender bias in images of physicians generated by DALL-E 2 across medical specialties.
